sentences.en: Such a statement I would not dignify with a response.
sentences.zh: 这样的声明我不屑一顾，不予回复。

sentences.en: I corrected the sentence after almost one month without response.
sentences.zh: 我几乎等了一个月才收到回复，于是修改了句子。

sentences.en: I didn't expect such a nasty response to my question.
sentences.zh: 我对这个问题本不抱期望，没想到会得到如此恶毒的回应。

senses.zh: 回答，答复；反应，响应；反应能力；感应；应答
